verdict.rationale: Lovable's docs say publishing deploys a snapshot of the project to a shareable live URL (default xxx.lovable.app) in two clicks with working defaults. You can also just ask the chat to "publish my app" or "ship it" and it handles the deploy, on Lovable-hosted infrastructure with nothing to configure. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the one-step publish works as described.
